evals.name: multi-pass-opus-campaign
evals.prompt: Run refinement passes 6 to 10 of my spec-prep plan in agy on claude-opus-5-5-high, full V(10,3,1) council per pass. The plan tree, five earlier pass records and two big dossiers are under ~/.local/share/spec-prep/. Write the prompts and the driver manifest.
evals.expected_output: Five units (one per pass), a Gemini pack-building unit before the first Opus unit, prompts built from the template with resume and checkpoint protocols, full council preserved, a units.tsv for agy-run.sh with verify commands, and a calibration step before the full campaign.
assertions: Each pass is its own agy session/unit
Prompts do not instruct whole-file reading of the corpus; only the context pack is read whole
The council parameters V(10,3,1) are kept unchanged
Effort level stays at the operator's choice (no downgrade suggested)
Includes a resume protocol and a done-marker per unit
Uses the Gemini pool for corpus distillation or pack building

evals.name: recover-from-429
evals.prompt: My agy run died with: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (code 429): Individual quota reached. Resets in 4h33m58s. It was in the middle of pass 6 and had already edited spec.md. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: Classifies as short window, explains the weekly-drain risk of relaunching a full-ingest prompt, prescribes diffing against the last snapshot, preserving unrecorded edits as a diff to re-vote, and relaunching the same unit with a resume protocol after reset plus jitter.
assertions: Identifies the reset as the short window, not weekly
Warns that relaunching with full preload can trigger the weekly lock
Unrecorded edits are rolled back and preserved as candidate proposals, not silently kept
Relaunch resumes the same unit from its checkpoint

evals.name: sonnet-implementation-with-gemini-support
evals.prompt: Use agy to implement the 14 adopted spec changes across our Hono API using Sonnet, and have something double-check the result. The repo is 900 files.
evals.expected_output: Gemini Flash or Pro builds a file index and pack, Sonnet units split by module with quiet test runs and incremental checkpoints, verify commands per unit, and a Gemini Pro independent review unit on the other pool.
assertions: Splits the implementation into module-sized units
Uses quiet test output and line-range reads
Puts the review on the Gemini pool
